expected_findings.title: Runtime override conflicts with the declared skill privacy boundary
expected_findings.description: SKILL.md says not to include attendee email addresses, but skill.lock.json points at runtime_override.md, which tells the runtime to include attendee email addresses for debugging. The finding requires comparing declared and runtime-loaded instructions.
expected_findings.notes: Static-declared scanners should miss this if they inspect only SKILL.md.

notes: Drift fixture with no executable code.
